content.comment_body: Hello, I'm trying to set up a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. I can't find this device in the device selection menu, and have attempted all listed devices. Downloading appears successful, but when starting [product_name], I receive a message stating the target device does not match. Any ideas what I could be missing?
Hi [user_name], Make sure you have the latest version of [product_name] software ([version_no]) installed, and double-check that the selected hardware version is [version_no]. Hope this helps!

You must use the current version of [product_name] software ([version_no]). This upgrade can be downloaded for free, but the file is export restricted and requires additional registration. For non-corporate use, select 'Private use' in the company field. For further details, refer to [document] or [url].
Unfortunately, that does not solve the issue. A [product_name] with article number ending with [article_no] should be selected as [version_no] in the hardware menu, not as [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering problems selecting the correct device in the software for their specific hardware model. They get mismatch errors when trying to run the system due to confusion over device identification and compatibility with corresponding software versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily find and select their exact device model within the software and have it operate correctly once selected.
